Independent EVM pool conservation and Claim receipt progress do not by themselves link settlement to the exact original native earning interval.

Reconcile each pool capture with the original native interval once; exclude duplicate capture and preserve unmatched obligations.
Carry obligations across RootMissed and later entitlement/payment epochs without assigning earnings to payment time or counting them twice.
Reject equal aggregate totals with changed recipients, boundary substitutions and mismatched liquid/collateral/recycle branches.
Distinguish authenticated amounts from full10/90 conformance, complete quantization and independently approved runtime/fee authority.
limits: Source finding, not a reproduced production accounting loss.
